reason: 7525a38af5 introduces the bad trait-parameter split in is_dyn_method for MIR evaluation, but lookup_impl_method already has the split in its parent; fix-parent blame traces it to c60b1f6414. The 20b12c2bac highlighting test resolves T::deserialize through lookup_impl_method and does not evaluate a dyn call, so it cannot validate the newly added copy of the bug.

c0aeb5204c introduces a completion call to Module::import_source and a source map with no entry for glob imports. The actual panic is the missing source-map entry indexed by ImportId, and 49f13d3a9b records the UseTree for every import and adds completion inside braces next to foo::*.

6a7b905c86 replaces the empty eager input token map with the entire original token map after remapping the expanded token tree. c7b34e4873 filters that map to the mapped IDs and extends the highlighting golden with nested include!(concat!(...)), whose inner argument tokens disappear in the expanded input.

73bab32aef adds the unconditional NumericLiteral tag for minus under a PrefixExpr. c9af469b85 checks the operand and adds a highlighting fixture containing unary minus on both a literal and a variable.

fa43ef30f4 adds an expect on BindPat::name in ExprCollector while field_pat_list can recover by creating a BindPat without a name. c0c3b37255 replaces the expects with filtering and adds infer_std_crash_4, whose unsupported box-pattern syntax exercises this recovery.

309421c117 changes the already-unresolved qualifier branch, but path_import_candidate already rejected resolved non-ADT qualifiers in its parent, including the primitive resolution needed by the str::from_utf8_unchecked regression. The fix-parent blame traces the outer resolve_path match to 005bc49d744.

da08198bc9 merges source-map records that still contain a per-node InFile, preserving the definition file ID. 08adce61a1 introduces the single file_id representation that b32f611b6e repairs and exercises with the outline-module doctest highlighting golden.

f7be314579 changes the canonical representation, but normalize_trait_assoc_type already builds a type-only goal and the pre-change Chalk bridge already rewrites lifetime binders into type binders. The iterator-hint fixture in efb56160c9 verifies the later normalization using InferenceTable, without tying the absence of lifetime normalization to this refactor.

1f4870ff1c introduces f64-backed storage, but the intro tree uses it only for display and type inference ignores the value. cd67589f63 adds into_f32 and MIR lowering that performs the second rounding; 320022622c's const-hover regression needs that later path.

fe7bf993aa introduces the flag update in infer_expr, while match arms call infer_expr_inner directly. ea1d0bccef fixes the resulting missed divergence for bare never-typed arms by moving the update into infer_expr_inner, and tests the resulting type mismatches; the row describes the opposite direction.

Blame traces the new is_comment predicate to 1c866573cb, widening the unchanged filter(...).last() to pick the ordinary standalone comment after a struct. The new snapshot expects the import before the struct, whereas the old insertion picks the later comment.

Blame traces statements.last() and emission of RemoveTrailingReturn to 2987fac76f, where HIR collect_stmt discards item statements. The new test requires no diagnostic for a return followed by an inner fn, which the original HIR query sees as terminal.

The fix changes the intermediate Namespace::Types apply_substs call blamed to 82fe7b77a3, and 5d72b96988 supplies the new alias type, but the asserted arity panic exercised by bug_1030 starts at 1ee779d1f7. At the submitted intro, the malformed substitutions are transient for this fixture: associated-item lookup uses the ADT fingerprint, then replaces the intermediate type with the method definition.

Blame attributes the full-type equality to 41f470fea8, which also enables Self search in find_all_refs. Comparing the declared ADT type with the impl's instantiated type loses generic Self references, and the new snapshot checks both missing Self ranges.

Blame points to 970276b559 for selecting opaque lowering and folding RPITs only after make_ty_with_mode has registered projection obligations. The generic alias test inserts an RPIT with a free bound variable into a projection and expects successful inference of its returned tuple.

Blame traces AboveWholeItem's full range to 8a2803d9ae, while resolve_annotation uses that range's start as the identifier lookup offset. The intro itself adds the exact documented/attributed struct snapshot with HasReferences data: None, and the fix changes it to Some([]), so admission depends on whether a pinned snapshot counts as pre-flagging when its test name only asserts placement.
